text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَيَحْمِلُنَّ أَثْقَالَهُمْ وَأَثْقَالًۭا مَّعَ أَثْقَالِهِمْ ۖ وَلَيُسْـَٔلُنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ

words.gloss_range: initial connective opening a fresh sworn declaration while linking it to the prior false promise and verdict
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) does not let 29:13 begin as an unrelated prediction. It resumes a new sworn declaration while keeping the prior claim and verdict in view, so the consequence sounds joined to what has just been exposed in 29:12. Because the particle fuses into the first oath complex, the boundary itself becomes part of the first verbal beat, and the ayah then unfolds as two oath-marked consequences: carried burden and later questioning.

topics.headline: linked boundary opening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse opens a new decree while still carrying forward the prior false promise in 29:12.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as a conjunction with resumptive force, and the clause evidence starts the first oath-clause at this word.

topics.headline: connective enters oath architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening connection is heard inside the first oath complex and prepares the two-beat structure of carrying and questioning.
topics.reason: The local clause structure licenses the first emphatic carrying clause and the coordinated second emphatic questioning clause.

words.gloss_range: oath prefix on the first verb, binding the carrying clause into emphatic sworn certainty
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is the first oath prefix, so the carrying is not framed as a loose forecast. Its force works with the heavy emphasis suffix on the verb, placing the whole first burden-bearing clause under sworn certainty. The same architecture returns at word 10, which makes carrying and questioning parallel decrees rather than one main consequence with a secondary afterthought.

topics.headline: first sworn carrying clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first consequence is sworn into certainty across the verb and its burdens.
topics.reason: QAC identifies this as the oath prefix attached to the emphatic imperfect, and the first clause includes the carrying verb and both burden objects.

topics.headline: paired oath architecture
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first oath prefix anticipates the matching second oath prefix, balancing burden and questioning as twin outcomes.
topics.reason: The second coordinated clause repeats the oath-prefix plus heavy-emphasis frame on the passive questioning verb.

words.gloss_range: active emphatic future carrying, locally moral load-bearing made certain by oath morphology and tied to owned and added burdens
words.root_gloss_range: carrying, bearing, transporting, pregnancy-bearing, and responsibility-bearing; the local Form I active selects self-carried moral liability rather than an explicit loading construction
words.prose: {{ar:يَحْمِلُنَّ}} ({{tr:yaḥmilunna}}) turns the prior human offer in 29:12 back onto its speakers as sworn future carrying. The verb is active Form I, so the carriers themselves remain grammatically responsible; the verse does not picture another agent loading them in the wording. The root range lets physical bearing and moral liability meet, and the adjacent burden nouns make guilt feel like a carried mass. The heavy emphasis suffix seals the verb with oath pressure; recitationally, the lighter carrying movement is immediately loaded by the repeated burden cluster, so the first clause gives the ayah an embodied and audible consequence before the later interrogation. A wider bearing scene such as the trust in 33:72 can illuminate the responsibility field, but here the object is the burdens produced by the false claim.

topics.headline: active sworn carrying
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb makes the subjects active carriers under emphatic oath force, not passive recipients of a load.
topics.reason: QAC marks an active Form I imperfect with heavy emphasis, and attachment evidence makes the burden nouns its direct objects.

topics.headline: physical bearing becomes liability
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices moral consequence becoming bodily load-bearing through the carrying verb and burden objects.
topics.reason: The local objects are burden nouns, so the physical carrying field is locally licensed as moral liability rather than a free dictionary expansion.

topics.headline: prior offer reversed
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same carrying field moving from the human offer in 29:12 to a divine sworn consequence in 29:13.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give the concrete 29:12 to 29:13 boundary, and the local oath morphology supports the reversal from offer to decree.

topics.headline: embodied first beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first verbal beat is both embodied and audibly weighted before the verse moves to judicial questioning.
topics.reason: The subject is carried by verb agreement, the unselected loading form is not the local surface, and the clause structure places carrying before the passive questioning beat.

words.gloss_range: their own multiple burdens as the first direct object, definite by possession and concrete enough to make liability feel weighable
words.root_gloss_range: heaviness, weight, load, burden, gravity, and measurable weight; locally selected as owned moral burdens carried under oath
words.prose: {{ar:أَثْقَالَهُمْ}} ({{tr:athqālahum}}) names the first load as their own, not a vague burden. Its accusative object role means the burdens receive the carrying action directly, and the broken plural makes the liability multiple rather than a single blur. The root field of weight turns moral consequence into something heavy and weighable, while this first possessed form starts the threefold burden chain that will frame the added indefinite burden in the middle. The echo of burdens in 99:2 broadens the eschatological field, but here ownership is localized by the suffix.

topics.headline: owned burdens as object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first burden is specifically owned by the same group and is the thing actually carried.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes this noun the direct object of the active carrying verb, and QAC marks possession by the third-person plural suffix.

topics.headline: weighable moral load
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word does not merely label sins but makes liability feel heavy, multiple, and measurable.
topics.reason: The noun is locally paired with the carrying verb, so the root's weight field is directly licensed by the local construction.

topics.headline: first term of burden chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first burden as the opening edge of an accumulating threefold burden pattern.
topics.reason: The same plural burden noun recurs at words 4, 6, and 8, with the middle indefinite form coordinated and the final possessed form governed by the accompaniment phrase.

words.gloss_range: additive conjunction joining a second burden object to the first and pivoting from owned burden to extra burden
words.prose: The middle {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) is not a neutral list marker. It coordinates a second accusative burden with the first, so the clause adds weight to weight rather than replacing one liability with another. In the ayah's connective pattern, this is the internal addition link: the first connective opens the judgment, this one adds the extra load, and the later connective opens the second sworn clause.

topics.headline: burden added to burden
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the conjunction makes the second burden additive, not an alternative to the first.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the second burden noun with the first and treats it as another direct object of the carrying verb.

topics.headline: three connective roles
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this connective as the ayah's internal addition point between the opening boundary and the second oath-clause hinge.
topics.reason: The three connective particles occupy distinct structural slots: opening the first clause, adding the second burden object, and introducing the second sworn clause.

words.gloss_range: indefinite additional plural burdens, coordinated as a second carried object and left open in source, amount, and scope
words.root_gloss_range: heaviness, weight, load, burden, gravity, and measurable weight; locally the same burden root reappears as an unspecified extra load
words.prose: {{ar:أَثْقَالًۭا}} ({{tr:athqālan}}) is the added load at the center of the burden sequence. It is accusative and coordinated with the first object, but unlike the possessed flanking forms it is indefinite, leaving the source and measure of the extra burdens open. That openness makes the added liability feel expandable while still keeping it concrete as weighable load. The parallel burden formula in 16:25 helps explain the extra-load logic, and the local triple repetition makes the middle term sound like added weight inside an owned-burden frame.

topics.headline: open-ended extra burdens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the extra burdens are left indefinite, making their amount and source open while still counted as carried weight.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as indefinite accusative, and attachment evidence makes it a coordinated second object under the carrying verb.

topics.headline: middle of burden chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the indefinite middle burden as the expanding center between the two possessed burden forms.
topics.reason: The local sequence repeats the burden noun three times with changed determination, and the concrete comparison to 16:25 supports the added-burden logic without replacing the local parse.

topics.headline: unspecified but weighable
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that indefiniteness does not make the load vague; it remains a real object of carrying.
topics.reason: The word is grammatically an object of carrying, while its indefinite form leaves the quantity and source unspecified.

words.gloss_range: accompaniment adverb governing the following genitive burden phrase and making the added burdens simultaneous with their own burdens
words.root_gloss_range: with-ness, accompaniment, togetherness, and association; locally an adverbial construct of accompaniment rather than a broad root-derived image
words.prose: {{ar:مَعَ}} ({{tr:maʿa}}) keeps the extra burdens from becoming a replacement or later installment. It governs the following possessed burden phrase and makes the added load simultaneous with their own burdens, so the image is stacking: extra burdens with their burdens. The common accompaniment word is therefore structurally decisive here, and even its nasal opening helps bind it into the following burden phrase; broader root-field pressure remains secondary to the local adverbial construction.

topics.headline: governed accompaniment phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the added burdens are carried with the possessed burdens in one governed accompaniment phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes this word the adverbial accompaniment marker and the following burden phrase its genitive complement.

topics.headline: simultaneous burden stacking
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices addition as simultaneous stacking, not sequence or exchange.
topics.reason: The local phrase attaches to the added burden and governs the final possessed burden, making accompaniment the relation between the loads.

topics.headline: common word with local pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that a common accompaniment marker becomes locally weight-bearing because it binds the burden phrase into the stack.
topics.reason: The broader root-field and sound observations are kept as local accompaniment pressure, while the adverbial construction remains the controlling evidence.

words.gloss_range: their own burdens as the genitive complement of accompaniment, re-closing the burden frame after the added indefinite load
words.root_gloss_range: heaviness, weight, load, burden, gravity, and measurable weight; locally repeated as the governed possessed burden that completes the stack
words.prose: {{ar:أَثْقَالِهِمْ}} ({{tr:athqālihim}}) closes the first oath-clause by returning to their own burdens after the indefinite extra load. Its genitive case is governed by the accompaniment word, so the final burden phrase completes the relation: extra burdens with their burdens. The same pronoun remains live, but the vowel and case shift show that the repeated ownership is now inside a governed phrase. As the third burden noun, it completes the local A-B-A shape and lets the repeated weight root land before the clause break.

topics.headline: governed owned burdens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that ownership returns under genitive governance, so their burdens remain the frame around the added load.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as genitive with a third-person plural suffix, and attachment evidence makes it the governed complement of the accompaniment marker.

topics.headline: A-B-A burden closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the third burden noun as the closing edge of the owned-extra-owned burden envelope.
topics.reason: The local clause repeats the burden noun three times, with the final possessed genitive phrase completing the accompaniment construction.

topics.headline: ownership dispute reappears
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same group's ownership remains central after the verse has added an unspecified extra load.
topics.reason: The possessive suffix resumes the same third-person plural group whose burden-carrying claim was denied in the prior context.

words.gloss_range: clause-level conjunction introducing the second sworn consequence and shifting from burden-bearing to interrogation
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the second sworn clause and keeps it cumulative with the first. The ayah does not leave the consequence at carried weight; it adds questioning as a coordinated outcome. Structurally, this connective is the hinge where the scene moves from the burden field to the interrogation field while preserving the same oath architecture.

topics.headline: second sworn clause hinge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that questioning is added as a coordinated sworn consequence, not a loose afterthought.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence coordinates the passive questioning clause with the carrying clause through this conjunction.

topics.headline: from weight to questioning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the discourse shift from embodied burden to judicial interrogation at the connective.
topics.reason: The first clause ends with the burden stack and the second begins with an oath-marked passive questioning verb.

words.gloss_range: second oath prefix, binding the passive questioning clause into the same emphatic certainty as the carrying clause
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) repeats the oath prefix before the passive questioning verb. This gives the interrogation its own sworn force rather than letting it trail behind the burden scene. The repeated prefix balances the two consequences: they will surely carry, and they will surely be questioned.

topics.headline: sworn interrogation clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the questioning is independently oath-marked as certain.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a second oath prefix before the passive emphatic imperfect, and attachment evidence makes it the head of the second coordinated clause.

topics.headline: mirror of first oath
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the repeated oath pattern tying the two consequences into a balanced pair.
topics.reason: The first and second emphatic clauses share the same oath-prefix and emphasis-suffix architecture.

words.gloss_range: passive emphatic future questioning, locally judicial accountability about fabricated content with the interrogating agent grammatically suppressed
words.root_gloss_range: asking, requesting, questioning, interrogating, and being held to account; locally selected as passive judicial questioning governed by a content phrase
words.prose: {{ar:يُسْـَٔلُنَّ}} ({{tr:yusʾalunna}}) shifts the ayah from active carrying to passive interrogation. The subjects who actively carry are now grammatically placed under questioning, while the questioner is suppressed by the passive form. The root can cover asking and request, but the local passive form, the resurrection-time phrase, and the content complement select judicial accountability: they will be questioned about what they had been fabricating. The heavy emphasis suffix gives this interrogation the same oath pressure as the carrying verb, and parallels such as 15:92, 15:93, and 37:24 show the reckoning pattern without overriding the local wording.

topics.headline: passive sworn questioning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same plural group is not asking; they are placed under emphatic passive questioning.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as passive with heavy emphasis, and attachment evidence notes the suppressed interrogating agent.

topics.headline: questioning about fabrication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the questioning is directed toward the fabricated content, not left as general accountability.
topics.reason: The content phrase governed after the passive verb supplies what they are questioned about.

topics.headline: active carrying to passive questioning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the agency reversal: active bearers of burden become passive defendants under interrogation.
topics.reason: The first verb is active and the second is passive, while the coordinated clause structure keeps the same plural group in view.

topics.headline: reckoning pattern under oath pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the questioning verb as part of a judgment-day reckoning pattern whose sound still carries emphatic pressure.
topics.reason: The supplied parallels connect questioning with judgment-day accountability, and the local surface includes the arresting consonant and emphatic ending.

words.gloss_range: singular accusative time adverb in construct, fixing the questioning at the appointed resurrection day before the charge is named
words.root_gloss_range: day, time, appointed period, and bounded occasion; locally selected as the fixed judgment-time of interrogation
words.prose: {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}) locates the passive questioning before the verse names the charge. As an accusative time adverb in construct with the resurrection noun, it turns questioning into an appointed event rather than abstract accountability. The singular construct phrase gives the time a defined identity, and its placement between the passive verb and the content pivot foregrounds when they are questioned before saying about what. This also moves the scene from the worldly bargain of 29:12 into resurrection reckoning.

topics.headline: appointed time phrase
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the questioning is fixed at a singular, definite appointed time through the construct phrase.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the noun as an accusative time adverb in construct with the following definite resurrection noun.

topics.headline: resurrection reckoning frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the questioning as scheduled resurrection reckoning, not merely later accountability.
topics.reason: The local phrase combines the day noun with the definite resurrection noun, matching the supplied eschatological collocation profile.

topics.headline: time before charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verse first relocates the scene to resurrection before naming fabrication as the charge.
topics.reason: The word order places the temporal phrase after the passive questioning verb and before the content phrase.

words.gloss_range: the definite resurrection event completing the time construct and making the questioning a known eschatological standing-for-account scene
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, establishing, setting upright, and collective standing; locally selected as the named resurrection event in a time construct

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the preceding construct day noun that the resurrection noun completes

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ}} ({{tr:al-qiyāmati}}) gives the generic day its named identity: the known resurrection event. Its definiteness and event-noun form keep the phrase from meaning an indefinite rising, while the root image of rising and standing makes the questioning scene feel like subjects raised to stand for account. The word completes the construct phrase after {{ar:يَوْمَ}} ({{tr:yawma}}), and waṣl binds the two words smoothly in recitation; it belongs to a recurrent judgment-day formula and links the burden language to reckoning imagery such as weighing on the day in 7:8 and 7:9.

topics.headline: known resurrection event
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the phrase as the definite named resurrection event, not a generic rising or date label.
topics.reason: QAC marks the noun as definite and genitive as the second term of the time construct.

topics.headline: rising and standing pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices resurrection not as a bare date but as a collective standing-for-account scene, while the local noun remains the named event.
topics.reason: The root family supports rising and standing pressure, but local grammar selects the definite resurrection event rather than activating every root derivative.

topics.headline: formulaic judgment frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the named day as a recurrent formula that frames questioning and burden-bearing within judgment reckoning.
topics.reason: The supplied rows connect this phrase to the recurrent day-resurrection formula and to concrete reckoning parallels at 7:8 and 7:9.

words.gloss_range: contracted about-what content pivot, supplying the governed target of passive questioning and opening onto what or the act that they fabricated
words.prose: {{ar:عَمَّا}} ({{tr:ʿammā}}) turns the clause from the time of questioning to its content. The contracted form gathers the prepositional relation and the content pronoun into one pivot after the resurrection-time phrase, so the interrogation is about the fabrication field rather than vague accountability. Locally, the content element can be heard as what they fabricated or as their fabricating as an act; both readings keep the charge tied to the following habitual fabrication verb.

topics.headline: content of interrogation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the questioning is directed toward the fabrication content, not left open-ended.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the contracted phrase the governed content complement of the passive questioning verb and the object field of the fabrication verb.

topics.headline: compact contracted pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the compact surface as the hinge from resurrection time to interrogation content.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the surface as a contracted preposition plus content pronoun form.

topics.headline: what fabricated or fabricating
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the charge can cover both fabricated things and the fabricating practice, while local syntax keeps both under the same questioning frame.
topics.reason: The content element permits relative and verbal-noun construals, but both are governed by the passive questioning clause and completed by the following fabrication verb.

words.gloss_range: perfect auxiliary with plural subject marker, forming habitual past with the following imperfect rather than a simple existential statement
words.root_gloss_range: being, existing, occurring, becoming, and forming; locally grammaticalized as an auxiliary that frames fabrication as repeated past practice
words.prose: {{ar:كَانُوا۟}} ({{tr:kānū}}) frames the final fabrication verb as habitual past: not one isolated lie, but what they used to do. The local construction makes the verb auxiliary rather than a simple statement of existence, yet the being-root still gives the practice a settled-state feel. Its plural suffix carries the same group into the final charge, and the long-vowel cadence stretches the habitual frame toward the ayah's closing verb.

topics.headline: habitual past frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices fabrication as a repeated past practice, not a single completed event.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the perfect verb as an auxiliary governing the following imperfect predicate.

topics.headline: settled practice pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the auxiliary frame makes fabrication feel like an established past condition, while local grammar keeps the auxiliary reading primary.
topics.reason: The root range supports being and forming pressure, but the local construction selects the aspectual auxiliary function.

topics.headline: same group carried to final charge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the same plural actors carried into the habitual fabrication frame at the ayah's close.
topics.reason: The bound plural marker and the supplied co-occurrence profile keep the same agents linked to the following fabrication verb.

words.gloss_range: habitual Form VIII fabrication, deliberate manufactured falsehood gathered as the content of questioning and placed as the ayah's closing charge
words.root_gloss_range: fabricating, forging, inventing falsehood, with other root-family branches such as cooling or slackening kept outside the selected Form VIII sense except as narrowed contrast
words.prose: {{ar:يَفْتَرُونَ}} ({{tr:yaftarūna}}) is the final charge that explains both earlier consequences. After the auxiliary, its imperfect form makes fabrication habitual, and Form VIII marks involved, deliberate forging rather than a generic mistake. The object is not spelled out in a separate accusation phrase; the preceding content pivot gathers whatever they fabricated into the matter of questioning. The broader root family includes cooling or slackening branches, but the local derived form selects active fabrication, so those branches remain contrast rather than local sense. As the last word, the verb names the behavior that produces the carried burdens and the resurrection questioning; its plural ending keeps the fabricators grammatically present and echoes the earlier plural emphatic verb endings. The wider formula of fabricating lies against God appears in 6:21, 6:93, 7:37, 11:18, and the same surah makes the charge explicit in 29:68.

topics.headline: habitual deliberate fabrication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final verb as repeated, deliberate fabrication rather than one ordinary false statement.
topics.reason: QAC marks the verb as Form VIII imperfect governed by the habitual auxiliary, and the local construction makes it the repeated practice under question.

topics.headline: fabrication content gathered by pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fabricated object is compressed into the questioning content rather than stated as a separate object phrase.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats the content element in the contracted pivot as the thing fabricated and as the governed content of questioning.

topics.headline: fabrication selected over slackening
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local derived form selects active forgery while other root-family branches remain contrastive background.
topics.reason: The Form VIII surface and local context select fabrication, so cooling or slackening branches should not be treated as active local senses.

topics.headline: final charge explains consequences
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final word as the causal endpoint that explains the opening burden and the intervening questioning.
topics.reason: The word closes the ayah after the carrying and questioning clauses, and the repeated plural verb endings keep the same actors threaded through the sequence.

topics.headline: fabrication formula field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices this local charge as part of a wider formula field of fabricated claims, including explicit against-God formulations elsewhere.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give concrete formula parallels at 6:21, 6:93, 7:37, 11:18, and a same-surah specification at 29:68, while the local wording keeps the complement compressed.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated أَثْقَالَ/أَثْقَالًا/أَثْقَالِ, the possessives, and مَعَ attach added weights alongside their own.
baseline_models.mechanism: Carriage preserves personal attachment while the threefold weight lexeme and مَعَ make liability additive rather than substitutive: an original load remains and further loads accompany it.

activation_trace.role: Bearing an entrusted burden supplies the carrier relation and functionally keeps liability attached to its bearer.
Weight opposed to lightness supplies literal and moral heaviness and functionally makes the repeated burdens cumulative.

changed_reading.after: They retain their own heavy liability while further weights accrue alongside it; neither the possessives nor مَعَ suggests that one person's load simply replaces another's.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: وَلَيُسْـَٔلُنَّ ... عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ joins emphatic passive questioning to their ongoing past fabrication.
baseline_models.mechanism: A fixed resurrection event converts sustained invented falsehood from speech that can pass in time into an object of compulsory account.

activation_trace.role: Questioning and demanding supply the literal summons and functionally open an account that requires an answer.
A day as a severe event supplies the decisive occasion and functionally fixes when the account becomes unavoidable.
Resurrection and the rising of creation supply the named event and functionally gather the carriers for account.
Occurrence through time supplies the durative past practice and functionally links repeated fabrication to the later question.
Inventing lies supplies the direct object of questioning and functionally identifies the conduct that generated the account.

changed_reading.before: They will be asked about lies.
changed_reading.after: They will face compulsory accounting for a sustained practice of producing falsehood, now treated as a durable accountable output.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَحْمِلُنَّ, the extra أَثْقَالًا, and قِيَٰمَةِ permit a guaranty-and-valuation register within the focus wording.
baseline_models.mechanism: Carrying can be assuming a guaranty, while weight can be measured value and rising can host valuation; the extra load may therefore be liability acquired through claims of responsibility for others.

activation_trace.role: Guaranty and indemnity supply an assumed obligation and functionally recast carrying as legal responsibility.
Known weight and measure supply quantification and functionally make the obligations assessable rather than merely felt.
Valuation and appraisal supply an audit register and functionally frame resurrection as the disclosure of what each assumed obligation is worth.

changed_reading.after: The carriers stand under appraised obligations, including added liability generated by what they purported to assume or guarantee.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding invitation ties following a path to a promise of carrying followers' sins, then denies that the speakers can carry any of those sins and calls them liars. The focus ayah reverses the false guaranty: followers' sins do not transfer, but recruiting them generates additional liability for the recruiters.

activation_trace.role: Guaranty supplies the focus's liability register and functionally receives the preceding verse's failed promise.
Repeated heaviness supplies the retained and added loads and functionally marks the cost of inducing others.
An attached consequence of following supplies literal تبعة and functionally links recruitment to the recruiter's added liability.
A traversed extended path supplies the invited course and functionally identifies the conduct into which others are recruited.
The promise and denial of carrying instantiate guaranty language and functionally expose the promise as incapable of transferring sin.
Sin and offense supply the expressly nontransferable objects and functionally preserve each follower's own liability.
Contradiction of truth supplies the verdict on the promise and functionally turns promised relief into an added burden for its speakers.

structural_cues: 29:12 is directly adjacent and repeats ح م ل in a promise followed by an explicit negation of carriage.
29:13 answers with two emphatic futures, triple ث ق ل, possessive loads, and مَعَ rather than a transfer construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies invitation, path, failed guaranty, nontransferable sins, and the next verse's added loads. I infer the causal arrow that inducing followers creates the leader's extra liability while followers retain their own; a live alternative is that the extra loads include broader consequences of falsehood, not only misled persons.

changed_reading.before: Added burdens might be other people's sins shifted onto these carriers.
changed_reading.after: No follower's sin is discharged onto a leader; rather, the leader's own load grows through the act and consequences of recruiting others onto the false path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The collocation of making and inversion turns fabrication from an isolated false sentence into production of a counter-reality that organizes worship and dependence; its downstream practices become part of the weight.

activation_trace.role: Invented falsehood supplies the focus object and functionally receives the context's more concrete production mechanism.
Accumulated heaviness supplies consequence and functionally gives produced falsehood durable moral mass.
Inventing speech and lies supplies deliberate manufacture and functionally enlarges fabrication from utterance to constructed system.
Turning a thing away from its proper direction supplies inversion and functionally explains how the manufactured fiction redirects worship and reliance.

structural_cues: 29:17 places تَخْلُقُونَ إِفْكًا amid worship of powerless objects and a contrast over provision.
29:13 asks about what they habitually fabricate, allowing an output and its effects, not only a momentary utterance, to be audited.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deliberate invention, directional inversion, false worship, and repeated weight. I infer that a manufactured fiction generates practices and dependencies that add to its maker's load; the live alternative is the narrower idiom 'invent a lie' without a craft-system emphasis.

changed_reading.before: They are questioned for saying false things.
changed_reading.after: They are questioned for constructing inverted realities that redirect conduct, with the produced system and its consequences accruing as weight.

context_deltas.mechanism: A worldly bond around fabricated objects becomes reciprocal repudiation and expulsion at the same resurrection event. The extra burdens can thus be relationally generated by mutual reinforcement even though final liability remains partitioned among persons.

activation_trace.role: Plural heaviness supplies individual and accompanying loads and functionally receives consequences generated within a relation.
Mutual affection supplies the worldly social bond and functionally explains how a fabrication is maintained between participants.
The severe event-day supplies the temporal reversal point and functionally aligns this scene with the focus account.
The rising of creation supplies the same resurrection setting and functionally exposes the prior alliance.
Partition into reciprocal parties supplies each-against-each structure and functionally prevents collective solidarity from erasing individual shares.
Expulsion under anger supplies the bond's reversal and functionally converts mutual reinforcement into reciprocal accusation.

structural_cues: 29:25 moves from مَوَدَّةَ بَيْنِكُمْ in worldly life to repeated بَعْضُكُم بِبَعْضٍ on the Day of Resurrection.
The focus's مَعَ permits co-present burdens, while its possessives continue to mark personal ownership.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a social bond, a resurrection reversal, reciprocal partition, and accompanying personal loads. I infer that participation can generate co-burdens through mutual reinforcement; a live alternative is that 29:25 illustrates only idol-centered alliances and does not exhaust the focus's added burdens.

changed_reading.before: Each carrier has an isolated private stack of burdens.
changed_reading.after: Each carrier's stack remains personal but may contain liabilities generated through a network of mutual reinforcement whose solidarity collapses at resurrection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The tail/afterpart image in ذنب makes wrongdoing a consequence that follows its doer. It turns the focus's portable weight into the accumulated wake of action while 29:40's each-by-his-own formulation preserves exact attachment.

activation_trace.role: Bearing a burden supplies personal carriage and functionally gathers the consequences that remain attached to the agent.
Heaviness supplies the felt accumulation and functionally turns following consequences into a load.
The tail or afterpart supplies something that follows behind and functionally models sin as its doer's trailing consequence.

structural_cues: 29:40 says each was taken بِذَنۢبِهِۦ and closes by assigning wrongdoing to their own selves.
The focus repeats possessive burdens before adding burdens alongside them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the afterpart image, each person's own sin, self-wronging, and carried weights. I infer an act-to-aftereffect arrow in which consequences trail and accumulate behind the actor; the live alternative is a static ledger of offenses with no temporal wake image.

changed_reading.before: The burdens are a static inventory assigned at judgment.
changed_reading.after: The burdens are also the heavy wake of acts that have followed their makers and accumulated without losing personal attachment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Because the context presents a sufficient witness who already knows, the focus's passive questioning is not information gathering. It is an evidentiary procedure that makes the fabricated record manifest and answerable.

activation_trace.role: Demanding an answer supplies the literal question and functionally becomes formal elicitation rather than discovery.
Invented falsehood supplies the matter at issue and functionally becomes the record exposed by the procedure.
Testimony expressed with knowledge supplies evidentiary declaration and functionally frames the later question as establishment of accountability.
Disclosure of the object to the knower supplies prior knowledge and functionally rules out epistemic need as the question's purpose.

structural_cues: 29:52 joins sufficient witness with knowledge of what is in the heavens and earth.
29:13's emphatic passive question occurs at resurrection and specifies the already practiced fabrications as its object.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sufficient witness, prior knowledge, emphatic questioning, and a specified record. I infer that the question publicly establishes and confronts liability rather than supplying missing information; a live alternative is that the demand still centers on the carriers' own verbal answer.

changed_reading.before: The question seeks to learn what they fabricated.
changed_reading.after: The question confronts them with an already witnessed record so that fabricated claims become publicly answerable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later negated use of carrying separates what creatures need from what wrongdoers make: provision need not be stored or borne by the creature, while fabricated moral consequence remains an unavoidable personal load.

activation_trace.role: Bearing an entrusted burden supplies unavoidable moral carriage and functionally forms one side of the contrast.
Literal transport supplies the expressly negated carriage of provision and functionally distinguishes needed sustenance from self-produced liability.
An allotted gift supplies provision from outside the creature and functionally contrasts received support with burdens generated by one's acts.

structural_cues: 29:60 states that many creatures do not carry their provision and that God provides them and the addressees.
29:13 uses the same ح م ل root affirmatively and emphatically for burdens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a negated carriage of allotted provision and an affirmed carriage of fabricated consequence. I infer a contrast between received sustenance and self-generated liability; a live alternative is that 29:60 contributes only a physical transport image without classifying the moral load's origin.

changed_reading.before: Carrying burdens is simply one more image of having to transport what belongs to oneself.
changed_reading.after: The surah distinguishes provision one need not bear from consequence one cannot shed: fabricated liability, unlike sustenance, is a load the actor has generated.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated questions elicit the emphatic true answer 'God,' yet the respondents remain turned away. The resurrection question therefore exposes not mere ignorance but contradiction between admitted knowledge and fabricated orientation.

activation_trace.role: Demanding an answer supplies the focus procedure and functionally receives the context's demonstrated answer-revealing pattern.
Invented falsehood supplies the accountable practice and functionally stands against what the speakers themselves concede.
A direct question supplies elicitation of an admitted creator and functionally demonstrates questioning as contradiction exposure.
Being turned from the proper direction supplies the post-admission inversion and functionally locates failure in orientation rather than missing data.
A second direct question supplies repeated elicitation of the same admitted agent and functionally makes the contradiction patterned rather than incidental.

structural_cues: 29:61 and 29:63 each use a conditional question followed by emphatic لَيَقُولُنَّ ٱللَّهُ.
29:13 echoes the emphatic future shape in وَلَيُسْـَٔلُنَّ and joins it to habitual fabrication.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated elicited admissions, directional inversion, and a future question about fabrication. I infer that the final question exposes a lived contradiction between conceded truth and constructed allegiance; a live alternative is that the repeated questions merely teach propositions and do not model the final procedure.

changed_reading.before: They are questioned because their fabrications reflect lack of knowledge.
changed_reading.after: They are questioned to expose how their fabricated orientation contradicts truths they were already able to state.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's final recurrence of افترى specifies a concrete endpoint for the focus's broad relative clause: attributing a lie to God and denying truth when it arrives. Fabrication operates both by adding a false attribution and by rejecting a matching reality.

activation_trace.role: Invented falsehood supplies the broad focus category and functionally opens it to the later explicit instance.
Inventing a lie supplies the exact lexical recurrence and functionally specifies false attribution as a concrete burden-generating act.
Contradiction of truth supplies both lie and denial and functionally shows fabrication's additive and rejecting sides.
Stable correspondence with reality supplies the opposed standard and functionally makes the fabrication's distortion assessable.

structural_cues: 29:68 repeats the focus root ف ر ي in the construction ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا and pairs it with denial of the truth when it came.
The focus's عَمَّا remains grammatically broad, so the later case can specify without exhausting its range.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact lexical recurrence, false attribution, denial, and truth as the opposed standard. I infer that 29:68 is a culminating instance of what 29:13 audits; a live alternative is that the focus includes many other fabricated claims and should not be restricted to this instance.

changed_reading.before: The questioned fabrications are unspecified lies in general.
changed_reading.after: They include, with special force, false attribution to God and denial of arrived truth, while the focus's broad wording leaves other manufactured falsehoods included.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's form-distant س ل ل mapping for س ء ل and a craft branch of ف ر ي rather than their dominant senses. It remains anchored in the two focus roots and yields a coherent exposure mechanism; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory material analogy, not as the lexical definition of questioning or fabrication.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: يُسْـَٔلُنَّ and يَفْتَرُونَ are both focus forms with packet-supplied extraction and cutting/sewing branch options.

activation_trace.role: Drawing something out gently or secretly supplies extraction and functionally pictures questioning as pulling concealed construction into view.
Cutting for repair and stitching supplies tailored construction and functionally pictures each fabrication as assembled material with a traceable seam.
Heaviness supplies the resulting load and functionally makes the drawn-out construction part of what must be borne.

changed_reading.before: Questioning requests a report about prior lies.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, questioning draws the concealed threads of a fabricated construction into view, revealing how its assembled pieces became a load.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-domain load-bearing analogy: 29:41 speaks of a weak house, not directly of 29:13's burdens. It remains validly anchored through the focus's carrying, weight, and fabrication mechanism and through branch-backed context images; downstream prose should qualify it as a structural analogy for failed reliance, not equate every fabrication with the spider's house.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus combines carrying heavy outputs with fabrication, permitting a question about whether what was constructed could ever support its makers.

activation_trace.role: Bearing a burden supplies load-bearing responsibility and functionally asks who carries the consequence when a constructed support fails.
Heaviness supplies the imposed load and functionally tests the strength of the relied-upon construction.
Invented falsehood supplies the constructed reliance and functionally links failed support back to the accountable fabrication.
Shelter and dwelling supply a support structure and functionally model the protection expected from fabricated alliances.
Weakness of force supplies structural incapacity and functionally explains why the fabricated shelter cannot carry or protect against the resulting load.

changed_reading.before: Fabrications merely add weight to their makers.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, fabrications are also weak support structures: when relied upon they cannot bear or protect, so their makers are left carrying the consequences of the failed construction.

strongest_changes: The adjacent false guaranty makes the added burdens liabilities generated by recruiting followers, not transferred follower sins.
The making/inversion sequence turns fabrication into a constructed counter-reality with downstream weight.
Witness and repeated admission-producing questions recast the final question as public exposure of contradiction, not acquisition of information.
The tail image and reciprocal resurrection scene make burden both a trailing consequence and a socially generated but individually owned liability.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrence reuses the focus's core actions at decisive points: carrying is falsely promised in 29:12 and negated for provision in 29:60, questioning elicits true admissions in 29:61 and 29:63, and fabrication returns as false attribution against truth in 29:68. These recurrences turn a static penalty statement into a causal trace of recruitment, construction, consequence, and exposure.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the added burdens are specifically the liabilities of misguiding followers or a broader class of downstream consequences.
How much of the cutting, extraction, tail, and weak-house imagery should survive beyond exploratory prose.
Whether 29:68 should dominate the range of fabrication or remain one culminating instance within a broader category.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Recruitment adds weight without transferring it.** ث ق ل B001 is heaviness against lightness, and حمل B003 is bearing responsibility or sin. Three repetitions of أثقال surround the possessive distinction “their loads”/“loads with their loads.” I infer that caused imitation generates additional liability while each original burden remains attached; the ayah reverses the previous sales pitch from substitution into accumulation.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 29:60 supplies the unexpected inverse: vulnerable creatures are sustained without carrying provision, whereas fabricators must carry multiplied moral loads. Not every dependency is transferable, and not every necessary good is self-carried.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **False indemnity reverses into additive weight.** Lexical evidence: `لَيَحْمِلُنَّ`, root `ح م ل`, `B003` (bearing responsibility or sin), and repeated `أَثْقَال`, root `ث ق ل`, `B001` (heaviness) with `B004` (standard weight and weighing). Structural cue: `29:12` promises substitution, but this ayah repeats “their loads” before and after additional loads with `مَعَ`, making addition rather than transfer visible. Assigned role: weight materializes responsibility as something that can accumulate and be measured. Abductive move: I infer that inducing others along the route adds causal responsibility without removing the induced person's own load. Reading change: the recruiters' guarantee does not merely fail; it increases what they bear.

2. **Fabricated speech acquires mass and reaches a resurrection audit.** Lexical evidence: `يُسْأَلُنَّ`, root `س ء ل`, `B001` (asking); `ٱلْقِيَامَة`, root `ق و م`, `B013` (resurrection and rising); and `يَفْتَرُونَ`, root `ف ر ي`, `B003` (fabricating a lie). Structural cue: the sequence moves from carried weights to questioning about fabrication, after `29:10-12` displayed unstable and recruiting speech. Assigned role: fabrication is the causal act audited; rising supplies the occasion on which concealed liabilities stand forth. Abductive move: the packet supplies sequence, and I infer that speech becomes burden through the actions and followers it generates. Reading change: invented claims are no longer weightless utterances but causally embodied liabilities.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later activation (`29:40`, `29:55`):** Differentiated seizures give the abstract weights distinct material outcomes, and “taste what you worked” turns liability into experience. The burden image is thus not static bookkeeping: fabricated speech travels through induced action until it returns as embodied consequence.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An obligation remains attached to its actor as a load, guarantee, account, and claim until it is weighed and settled.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Moral burden is materialized as freight, surety, debt collection, and calibrated weight rather than as an abstract quantity.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Load, Surety, and Inseparable Liability
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A visible load is taken up under a guarantee, but the attached liability follows the responsible party and adds weight.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: an external load borne on back, head, mount, or vessel `quranic:root_000357:B001/m01`; entrusted burden or culpability `quranic:root_000357:B003/m01`; surety for damages and obligations `quranic:root_000357:B004/m01`; physical or figurative heaviness `quranic:root_000202:B001/m01`; calibrated weight `quranic:root_000202:B004/m01`; liability that follows its cause `quranic:root_000175:B006/m01`; deliberate offense `quranic:root_000420:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The promise to "carry your sins" sounds like a surety agreement, yet liability is not detached freight. It remains a following claim, so the guarantor accumulates another weighted obligation instead of substituting for the original actor.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca sırtta ya da başta görünen bir yükü değil, bir şeyi kaldırıp götürmeyi, soyut bir yükü üstlenmeyi ve suyun ya da taşıtın içindekileri götürmesini birlikte kapsar. Bu nedenle görünür yük çerçevesi korunabilir, ancak dalın tamamını tek başına karşılamaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Fiziksel taşıma çekirdektir; ileti ve suç yükü soyut uzantı, sel ve taşıt kullanımları ise taşıyan öznenin değiştiği özel gerçekleşmelerdir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın taşıma çekirdeğiyle sınırlı kalır; selin sürüklediği şey ve taşıtla götürme gibi yapıya bağlı kullanımlar ayrı yüzler olarak gösterilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi kaldırıp sırt, baş, hayvan veya taşıt üzerinde tutarak ya da götürerek yerini değiştirmektir. Aynı taşıma ilişkisi, ağır bir işi veya suç yükünü üstlenmeye ve suyun önüne kattığı maddeleri sürüklemesine uzanır.

facets.statement: Bir nesne kaldırılır, bir taşıyıcının üzerinde tutulur ve gerektiğinde başka yere götürülür.
Ağır iş, ileti veya suç gibi elle tutulmayan bir yük kişinin üzerine alınmış sayılır.
Sel çer çöpü sürükler, bir gemi veya başka taşıt da içindeki insanları götürür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı, kaldırıp götürme çekirdeğini hem somut yüklere hem üstlenilen soyut yüklere uygular; ayrıca selin sürüklediği artıklar ile insanların taşıtta götürülmesini bu ilişkiye bağlar.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi rahimde taşınan yavru ile ağacın üzerinde taşıdığı meyveyi açıkça aynı dalda verir. Geçici çerçeve bu iki içte veya bitki üzerinde gelişen ürünü doğru biçimde ayırır ve dıştan taşınan yükü kapsam dışında bırakır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal gebelikte rahimde gelişen yavruyu ve ağacın meyve vermesini kapsar; dış yük taşıma ya da gebelik olmadan süt gelmesi çekirdeğe dahil değildir.

Ağaç, üzerinde oluşup gelişen meyveyi kendi ürünü olarak taşır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yalnızca görevi üstlenmeyi değil, onu yerine getirme yükümlülüğünü, yerine getirmeyerek güveni bozmayı ve işlenen suçun yükünü taşımayı da bildirir. Geçici başlık kullanılabilir, fakat başarıyla yerine getirme ile ihmal veya suç sonucu doğan yük birbirinden ayrılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal yalnızca belirtilen görev, güven, ileti ve suç yapılarında geçerlidir; genel fiziksel taşıma anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişiye ileti, görev veya güvenilen bir iş yüklenmesi ve kişinin bunun gereklerini yerine getirmekle sorumlu olmasıdır. Görevi terk etmek güveni bozma, işlenen suç ise kişinin üzerinde kalan ağır bir yük olarak anlatılır.

facets.statement: Kişiye bir iletiyi ulaştırma veya güvenilen bir işi yerine getirme görevi verilir.
Yüklenen görevi gerçekten yerine getirmek ile onu terk ederek güveni bozmak karşıt sonuçlar olarak ayrılır.
İşlenen suçun sonucu, kişinin üzerinde kalan ağır ve kötü bir yük gibi kavranır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu anlatım bir görevin kişiye verilmesini, onun hakkını yerine getirme zorunluluğunu ve bunun terk edilmesiyle doğan güven bozulmasını ayırır; suç da taşıyan kişiye bağlanan bir yük olarak sunulur.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişiye güvenilen iş ya da ileti verildiğinde veya suçun sonucu onun üzerinde kaldığında kullanılan kapsayıcı karşılıktır.

Üstlenme, borcun veya hakkın yerine getirileceğine dair güvence verme işlevi görür.
Güvence veren kişi, hakkın yükünü asıl borçluyla birlikte taşıyan sorumlu taraf sayılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi terk edilip bulunarak büyütülen çocuğu, küçükken ülkesinden getirilen kişiyi, kökeni doğrulanamayan çocuğu ve başkasına ait sayılan çocuğu aynı ad altında toplar. Geçici çerçeve doğrudur, ancak ortak nokta yalnızca küçükken taşınmak değil, bu koşullar yüzünden soy bağının belirsiz veya tartışmalı kalmasıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, taşınma, bulunma ya da sonradan bir aileye bağlanma nedeniyle soyu doğrulanamayan kişiyi kapsar; genel çocukluk veya sıradan akrabalık anlamı taşımaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım belirli kişi adı ve miras yapısıyla sınırlı soy belirsizliğini korur; yalın taşıma veya genel çocuk anlamına genişletilmez.

concept_map.definition: Terk edilip bulunarak büyütülen, küçükken başka yerden getirilen, anne karnındayken annesiyle başka bir ülkeden getirilen veya sonradan bir aileye bağlanan ve bu yüzden gerçek soy bağı doğrulanamayan kişidir. Miras söz konusu olduğunda da belirleyici sorun bu soy belirsizliğidir.

facets.statement: Kişi bulunmuş, başka yerden getirilmiş veya bir aileye sonradan bağlanmış olduğu için soyu kesin olarak bilinmez.
Kaynak anlatımı terk edilmiş çocuk, yabancı yerden getirilen çocuk, anne karnındayken annesiyle başka bir ülkeden getirilen çocuk ve başkasına ait sayılan çocuk görünümlerini birlikte verir.
Soyun doğrulanamaması, kişinin miras hakkının nasıl belirleneceği sorununa bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı, terk edilmiş, küçükken başka yerden getirilmiş, anne karnındayken annesiyle başka bir ülkeden getirilmiş veya aileye sonradan bağlanmış kişileri doğrulanamayan soy ortaklığında toplar ve bunun miras bakımından sonuç doğurduğunu belirtir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Terk edilme, başka yerden getirilme veya sonradan bir aileye bağlanma yüzünden gerçek soyu belirsiz kalan kişi için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin taşınmış ya da bulunmuş olmasını ve bunun doğurduğu soy belirsizliğini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Terk edilmişken bulunan ve onu bulanlar tarafından büyütülen çocuk görünümünde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çocuğun terk edilmişken bulunmasını ve yeni çevrede büyütülmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Küçükken ülkesinden getirildiği veya başka bir aileye bağlandığı için soyu kanıtlanamayan kişiye uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Yer değiştirme ile doğrulanamayan soy arasındaki belirleyici bağı korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: terk edilmiş, başka yerden getirilmiş veya soyu doğrulanamayan çocuk

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal başka ülkeden getirilmiş veya başkasına ait sayılmış soyu belirsiz kişileri de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal annesi tarafından bırakılıp başkalarınca bulunan çocuğa özel olarak odaklanır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: bulunmuş çocuk ve soyu belirsiz çocuk
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal terk edilmişken bulunan ve öz ailesi kesin bilinmeyen çocuğu kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bulunmuş çocuk görünümünde örtüşürler; bu dal yerinden getirilme ve sonradan aileye bağlanma gibi daha geniş soy belirsizliği nedenlerini de içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal bulunmuş veya başka yerden getirilmiş olup soyu yalnızca belirsiz kalan kişiyi de içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle gerçek kökeni dışında bir aileye bağlanan kişiyi adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: soyu belirsiz ve başka soya bağlanmış çocuk
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal kişinin gerçek aile kökeniyle toplumda bağlandığı kökenin uyuşmamasını kapsayabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşuda yanlış veya sonradan kurulmuş bağ belirleyicidir; bu dalda ise bulunma ya da taşınma sonucunda kökenin yalnızca doğrulanamaması da yeterlidir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal soy belirsizliği taşıyan kişinin durumunu ve bundan doğan miras sorununu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal bir kişiyi belirli bir topluluğa veya gerçek babasından başkasına bağlama eylemini anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal gerçek köken ile kişiye yakıştırılan aile bağı arasındaki uyuşmazlık alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada odak kişinin belirsiz konumudur; komşuda ise o kişiyi başka bir soya bağlayan işlem veya iddia çekirdektir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Tüm adaylar değerlendirildi; bulunmuş çocuk, başka soya bağlanmış kişi ve soya bağlama eylemiyle yapılan karşılaştırmalar soy belirsizliğinin sınırını gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi kılıcı taşımaya yarayan kayışı, hayvan üzerine kurulan yolcu düzeneğini, yük taşımaya ayrılan hayvanları ve bunların üzerindeki yük veya yolcu düzenini açıkça sıralar. Geçici araç ve binek çerçevesi bu ortak taşıma işlevini doğru biçimde temsil eder.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal taşınan nesnenin kendisini değil, kılıcı, yolcuyu veya yükü taşıyan kayış, düzenek ve hayvanı adlandırır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım kayış, yolcu düzeneği, yük hayvanı ve armağan için verilen binek gibi ayrı biçimlere bağlıdır; bunlar tek bir yalın araç adı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Kılıcı bedene bağlayan kayış, hayvan üzerinde yolcu taşıyan düzenek veya yük taşımaya ayrılmış hayvan gibi taşıma işini sağlayan araçtır. Bazı biçimler yüklü hayvan topluluğunu ya da özellikle armağan edilen bineği de adlandırır.

facets.statement: Kılıç, omuzdan veya bedenden geçen bir kayışla taşınır.
Hayvanın üzerine yerleştirilen iki yanlı veya örtülü düzenek bir ya da daha çok yolcuyu taşır.
Deve, eşek veya başka bir hayvan yük taşımak üzere ayrılmış taşıyıcıdır.
Yüklü hayvanlar üzerlerindeki düzeneklerle birlikte veya armağan amacıyla verilen binek olarak adlandırılabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar aynı taşıma işlevi çevresinde kılıç kayışını, yolcu düzeneğini ve yük hayvanını ayırır; ayrıca yüklü hayvan topluluğu ile armağan için verilen bineğe özgü adları belirtir.

concept_gloss.text: taşıma kayışı, binek düzeneği veya yük hayvanı
concept_gloss.applicability: Taşınan şeye göre kayış, hayvan üstü yolcu düzeneği veya yük taşımaya ayrılmış hayvan türlerini birlikte gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Taşıma aracını, düzenek ile canlı taşıyıcı arasındaki tür ayrımını koruyarak kapsar.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kılıcı bedene bağlayıp taşımaya yarayan kayışın adlandırıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kılıcın kayışla asılarak bedende taşınması işlevini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deve veya başka bir hayvan üzerinde yolcu taşıyan iki yanlı ya da örtülü düzeneğe uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Düzeneğin hayvan üzerinde kurulmasını ve yolcu taşımasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deve, eşek veya başka bir hayvanın eşya taşımak üzere ayrıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın yük taşımaya ayrılmış canlı taşıyıcı olmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal özellikle devenin sırtındaki semer veya benzeri binek düzeneğini adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal deve üzerinde kurulan ve insan ya da yük taşımaya yarayan düzeneği kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal taşıma araçlarını kılıç kayışı ve yük hayvanına kadar genişletir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yolcuyu ve devenin hörgücünü çevreleyen belirli örtülü binek düzeneklerini ayrıntılandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: genel taşıma aracı ve örtülü binek
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal hayvan üzerinde yolcu taşımak için hazırlanan örtülü veya iki yanlı düzeneği içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşu dal belirli bir örtülü binek türünü merkez alır; bu dal onu daha geniş taşıma aracı ailesinin yalnızca bir görünümü olarak içerir.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal yolcu düzeneğinin yanında kayış ve yük taşıyan hayvanı da kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın çekirdeği farklı taşıma araçlarının işlevsel ailesidir; komşu dal semerin kendisini ve ona bağlı işi adlandırır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi güçlüğe rağmen bir işe girişme ve yolculukta kendini zorlama yanında, birine doğru eğilme ile güvenilip dayanılan şey anlamlarını da içerir. Bunları tek bir güçlük kavramında birleştirmek yanıltıcı olacağından dal, yapıya bağlı üç ayrı yüz olarak yeniden çerçevelenmelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Güçlük altında çabalama, birine doğru yüklenme ve güvenilir dayanak aynı biçim ailesindedir, fakat birbirinin yerine geçmeyen ayrı kullanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın bir kök anlamı varsaymaz; kendini zorlama, birine eğilme ve dayanak olma yüzlerini kendi yapıları içinde ayrı tutar.

concept_map.definition: Kişinin güç bir işi zorlanarak yapması veya yolculukta kendini son sınırına kadar itmesidir. Başka yapılarda birine doğru eğilip yüklenmeyi ya da güvenilip dayanılan kişi veya şeyi bildirir.

facets.statement: Kişi güçlüğe rağmen bir işi üstlenir ve onu yapmak için kendini zorlar.
Yolculuk sırasında kişi gücünü zorlayarak kendini yorar.
Belirli bir yapıda kişi başkasına doğru eğilir veya onun üzerine yüklenir.
Adlaşmış biçim, güvenilen ve gerektiğinde dayanılan kişi ya da şeyi gösterir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı güçlük altında çabalamayı ve yolculukta kendini yormayı bir araya getirir; ayrıca birine doğru eğilme ile güvenilir dayanak anlamlarını ayrı yapısal kullanımlar olarak verir.

concept_gloss.text: zorlanarak yüklenme, eğilme veya dayanak olma
concept_gloss.applicability: Bu biçim ailesindeki güçlük altında çabalama, birine doğru yüklenme ve güvenilir dayanak yüzlerini birlikte özetler.

error_profile.preserves: Birbirinden ayrılması gereken üç yapıya bağlı anlam yüzünü açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin güç bir işi yapmak veya yola devam etmek için kendi gücünü zorladığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İşin güçlüğünü ve kişinin kendi gücünü bilinçli biçimde zorlamasını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Hareketin başka bir kişiye doğru yönelmesini ve ağırlık vermesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişi veya şeyin güvenilip dayanılacak destek olarak değerlendirildiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Güvenme ve gerektiğinde destek alma işlevini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: birinin üzerine doğru eğilmek veya yüklenmek

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal güç yetirme, bütün çabayı harcama ve yaşam darlığı gibi daha genel güçlük alanlarına uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda kişi güç bir işi tamamlamak için elindeki gücü kullanır ve sıkıntıya katlanır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Çabalama yüzünde yakındırlar; bu dal belirli yapılarda kendini yükleme biçimini anlatır ve ayrıca çabayla ilgisiz eğilme ile dayanak yüzlerini taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kişinin güçlüğe rağmen işi üstlenip kendini zorlamasını eylem olarak bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yol veya işte hissedilen güçlük, ağırlık ve yorgunluk durumunun kendisini bildirir.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal zorlu iş veya yolculuk sırasında kişinin gücünün sınanması alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada odak kişinin kendini zorlayarak harekete devam etmesidir; komşuda odak kişinin yaşadığı güçlük ve ağırlıktır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal kişinin kendi isteğiyle güçlüğe girişip kendini zorlamasını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal insan veya hayvana taşıyamayacağı kadar ağır yük bindirilmesini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.gloss: kendini zorlama ve gücü aşan yük
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda taşıma veya çalışma gücü sınırına yaklaşan bir zorlanma vardır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı biçimi bir yandan öfkelenmek veya öfkenin kişiyi yerinden oynatması, öte yandan incitici davranışa ağırbaşlılıkla katlanmak için aktarır. Geçici çerçeve iki yönü de yakalar, fakat bunlar tek süreç değil birbirine karşıt kaynak varyantlarıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnızca belirtilen türemiş biçimlerde geçerlidir ve öfkeye kapılma ile öfkeyi denetleyip katlanma anlamları kesin olarak ayrı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım iki karşıt anlamı belirtilen türemiş biçime bağlı tutar; bunlardan yalın bir öfke veya sabır anlamı çıkarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir biçimde ya öfkeye kapılıp onun etkisiyle harekete geçmek ya da incitici davranışı öfkeyle karşılık vermeden ağırbaşlılıkla karşılamaktır. Kaynak anlatımı bu iki karşıt yönü aynı kullanım ailesinde verir.

facets.statement: Öfke kişiyi etkisi altına alır, onu huzursuz eder ve öfkeli tepkiye yöneltir.
Kişi kendisine yapılan incitici davranışı öfkesini denetleyerek ağırbaşlılıkla karşılar.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak anlatımı iki karşıt değer bildirir: öfkenin kişiyi etkisi altına alması ve kişinin incitici davranış karşısında öfkesini tutup ağırbaşlı davranması.

concept_gloss.text: öfkeye kapılma veya incinmeye ağırbaşlılıkla katlanma
concept_gloss.applicability: Aynı biçimin kaynaklarda aktarılan karşıt öfkelenme ve öfkeyi denetleyerek katlanma yönlerini birlikte belirtmek gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Öfkenin baskın gelmesi ile öfkenin denetlenmesi arasındaki karşıtlığı açıkça korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öfkenin kişiyi etkisi altına alıp onu huzursuz ettiği veya tepkiye yönelttiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Öfkenin kişide baskın hale gelmesini ve davranışını harekete geçirmesini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin kendisine yönelen kötülüğe öfkeli karşılık vermeyip kendini tuttuğu bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: İncinmeye rağmen öfkeyi denetleme ve karşılık vermeden dayanma tutumunu korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal ağırbaşlı katlanmanın karşıtı olan öfkeye kapılma anlamını da aynı biçimde taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal genel olarak aceleciliğin karşıtı olan ağırbaşlılık, sabır ve öfke denetimini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dalda kişi öfkesini bastırır ve incitici davranış karşısında ölçülü kalır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Ağırbaşlılık yüzünde yakındırlar; bu dal belirli bir davranışa katlanma bağlamına bağlıdır ve aynı zamanda karşıt öfkelenme anlamını da taşır.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal öfkenin yanı sıra ona karşı ağırbaşlılıkla katlanma anlamını da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal öfkeyi iç yanması ve yoğun üzüntüyle birleşen bir duygu olarak genişletir.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal kişinin öfke duygusuna kapılması ve bundan etkilenmesi alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dalın öfke yüzü yoğun üzüntüyü gerektirmez ve karşıt katlanma yüzüyle birlikte aktarılır; komşu dalda iç yanması belirgin bir ektir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal öfkeyi içte tutup dışa vurmama işlemini özellikle merkez alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal öfkenin davranışa dönüşmesini önleme ve kişinin kendini tutması alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Komşuda belirleyici işlem öfkeyi içeride hapsetmektir; burada ise incitici kişiye ağırbaşlı davranma sonucu öndedir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bu adı açıkça koyunun küçük yavrusu, özellikle bir yaşına yaklaşmış veya daha küçük birey için verir. Geçici çerçeve hayvan türünü ve yaş sınırını doğru korur; göksel adla ya da genel taşıma anlamıyla karışmaz.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal koyun türünün genç yavrusuyla sınırlıdır; bütün küçük çiftlik hayvanlarını, yetişkin koyunu veya gökteki burcu kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın adın genç koyun anlamını verir ve başka dallardaki göksel, gebelik ya da taşıma kullanımlarını içeri almaz.

concept_map.definition: Koyunun henüz genç olan yavrusu, özellikle bir yaşına yaklaşmış veya daha küçük bireyidir.

facets.statement: Ad, koyun türüne ait genç yavruyu belirtir.
Yaş bakımından bir yaşına yaklaşmış birey ve ondan daha küçük yavrular kapsama girer.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar adı koyunun genç yavrusu için ortak biçimde verir ve kapsamı bir yaşına yaklaşmış birey ile daha küçük dönemlere kadar açıklar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Koyunun genç yavrusunu, özellikle bir yaşına yaklaşmış veya daha küçük bireyi doğal Türkçeyle adlandırır.

error_profile.preserves: Koyun türünü ve yetişkinlik öncesindeki gençlik sınırını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yaşın özellikle vurgulandığı ve bir yaşına ulaşmamış koyun yavrusunun anlatıldığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Hayvanın koyun yavrusu olmasını ve genç yaşta bulunmasını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal da koyunun küçük yavrusunu aynı yaş ve tür çekirdeğiyle adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Kaynak kartlarında kavramsal sınırı değiştiren bir ayrım görünmez; ek dişi biçimi yalnızca aynı genç koyun kavramının söz varlığına aittir.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal yaş ayrımı yapmadan koyun türünü, dişi bireyi ve topluluk adlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Kuzu, komşu dalın adlandırdığı koyun türünün genç bireyidir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada yaş ve yavruluk kurucudur; komşu dal türün tamamını ve yetişkin bireyleri de kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal genç hayvanı koyun türüyle sınırlar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal koyun, keçi, sığır ve yabani sığır gibi birden çok türün yavrularını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal koyun yavrusunu kapsayan genç hayvan adlandırmalarında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal tür bakımından dar, yaş bakımından belirgindir; komşu dal farklı hayvan türlerinin yavrularına yayılan üst kapsamlı bir addır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi gökteki ilk burcu, onunla ilişkilendirilen hava dönemini, çok su taşıyan veya kara bulutu ve şimşeği aynı ad ailesinde toplar. Geçici çerçeve öğeleri doğru sayar, ancak burç ile hava olayları tek bir nesne değil, göksel ad çevresinde birleşen ayrı yüzlerdir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Göksel burç, ona bağlanan hava dönemi ve su yüklü bulut ya da şimşek ayrı tutulur; genç koyun anlamı bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım göksel adın yalın kullanımını bulut ve şimşek adlarından, ayrıca burca bağlanan yağış yapısından ayırır; bu yüzleri tek nesneye indirgemez.

concept_map.definition: Gökte burçlar kuşağının ilk bölümü ve bununla ilişkilendirilen hava dönemidir. Aynı ad ailesi çok su taşıyan ya da kara bulutu, şimşeği ve bu göksel döneme bağlanan yağışı da gösterebilir.

facets.statement: Ad, burçlar kuşağının ilk göksel bölümünü belirtir.
Aynı biçim çok su taşıyan veya kara görünen bulutu ve kimi anlatımda şimşeği adlandırır.
Belirli yağış veya hava dönemi göksel burcun doğuş ve batış çevrimine bağlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Toplu kaynak anlatımı burçlar kuşağının ilk bölümünü temel göksel ad olarak verir; çok sulu veya kara bulut, şimşek ve bu göksel döneme bağlanan yağış kullanımlarını bunun çevresinde toplar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Göksel burç ile ona bağlanan su yüklü bulut, şimşek ve yağış dönemi yüzlerini birlikte belirtmek gerektiğinde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Burç çekirdeğini ve onun çevresindeki bulut, şimşek ve yağış ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Burçlar kuşağının ilk göksel bölümünün adlandırıldığı gökbilim bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Göksel bölümün burçlar kuşağındaki ilk burç olmasını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bulutun koyu görünüşü ve içinde çok miktarda yağış suyu taşıması vurgulandığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bulutun kara görünmesini ve bol su taşımasını birlikte korur.

error_profile.preserves: Yağış ile göksel dönem arasında kurulan geleneksel zaman bağını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal farklı yıldız duraklarının doğuş ve batışlarına bağlanan yağmur, rüzgar, sıcak ve soğuk dönemlerinin genel sistemini kapsar.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bu dal tek bir göksel ada ve onun bulut ya da şimşek uzantılarına özgüdür; komşu dal yıldız duraklarına bağlı hava olaylarının genel çerçevesidir.

neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Bulut yüzünde yakınlaşırlar; bu dal bol su veya kara görünüşle yetinirken komşu dal damla büyüklüğü ve yağışın şiddetini sınırına ekler.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Bu dal şimşeği belirli göksel ad ve yağışlı bulut çevresinde adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal göğün gürlemesi, şimşek çakması ve gök gürültülü bulutu birlikte kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: İki dal yağışlı gökte görülen şimşek olayını ortak olarak içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Burada şimşek göksel ad ailesinin bir yüzüdür; komşu dalda şimşek ve gök gürültüsü doğrudan hava olayının çekirdeğidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi ağırlığı hafifliğin karşıtı olarak kurar; temel alan cisimlerdeki tartı veya baskın gelme duygusudur, sonra anlam alanlarına da taşınır. Geçici çerçeve bu çekirdeği yük, günah, ölçü birimi veya özel adlandırmalarla karıştırmadan verir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal çıplak ağırlık karşıtlığını anlatır; taşınan eşya, günah yükü ve ölçü adı ayrı dallardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bare kapsam, tanımı çıplak ağırlık ve hafiflik karşıtlığıyla sınırlar; özel birleşim anlamları içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin hafifliğe karşı ağır gelmesi, tartıda veya değerlendirmede baskın bir ağırlık taşımasıdır; önce cisimler için, sonra soyut nitelikler için kullanılır.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, hafifliğin karşıtı olan ağırlık ve ağır gelmedir.
Cisimlerdeki ağırlık çekirdeği, soyut durumlara ve değer yargılarına da taşınabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bu dalda ağırlığı hafifliğin karşıtı ve ağır olanın baskın gelişi olarak toplar; maddi alanın asıl, soyut kullanımın genişletilmiş alan olduğunu bildirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çıplak dalın maddi veya soyut hafiflik karşıtı çekirdeğini doğal biçimde verir.

error_profile.preserves: Hafifliğe karşı ağır gelme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin tartıda, bedende veya değerlendirmede hafif sayılmayacak biçimde baskın geldiği bağlamlara uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Baskın gelme ve hafiflik karşıtlığını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Maddi ağırlık modelinin soyut değer, söz veya sorumluluk alanına taşındığı yerlerde açıklayıcıdır.

error_profile.preserves: Soyut alana taşınan ağırlık fikrini korur.
error_profile.loses: Maddi cisimlerdeki temel ağırlık kullanımını dışarıda bırakır.

ağırlık, maddi ya da soyut ağır gelme niteliği

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal şeyin ağır olma niteliğini verir.
